# SOFTWARE-AS-A-SERVICE SUBSCRIPTION AGREEMENT

Made on 5 September 2026 between **Chambal Analytics Private Limited**, Jaipur, Rajasthan (the "**Provider**") and **Ganga Textiles Limited**, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh (the "**Customer**").

## 1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 "**Affiliate**" means, in relation to a Party, any entity that controls, is controlled by or is under common control with that Party.

1.2 "**Annual Subscription Fee**" means the fee specified in Schedule 2.

1.3 "**Cap**" means the amount equal to the Annual Subscription Fee actually paid by the Customer in the twelve (12) months before the claim arose.

1.4 "**Excluded Liabilities**" means liability arising from (a) fraud or wilful misconduct; (b) breach of Clause 8 (Confidentiality); or (c) the indemnity in Clause 9.1.

1.5 "**Early Termination Fee**" means an amount equal to fifty percent (50%) of the Annual Subscription Fee for the remainder of the then-current Subscription Term, but not exceeding the Annual Subscription Fee for one year.

1.6 "**Subscription Term**" means the initial term in Clause 3.1 and each renewal term.

1.7 Where a Schedule conflicts with the body of this Agreement, the body of this Agreement prevails, except in respect of Fees, where Schedule 2 prevails.

## 2. SUBSCRIPTION

2.1 The Provider grants the Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable right for its employees and the employees of its Affiliates to access and use the Platform during the Subscription Term.

2.2 The Customer shall not sublicense, resell or reverse engineer the Platform.

## 3. TERM AND RENEWAL

3.1 The initial Subscription Term is twenty-four (24) months from 5 September 2026.

3.2 The Subscription Term shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term. The Provider shall send the Customer a written renewal reminder between sixty (60) and ninety (90) days before the end of each term.

## 4. FEES AND PAYMENT

4.1 The Customer shall pay the Annual Subscription Fee annually in advance within thirty (30) days of invoice.

4.2 The Provider may increase the Annual Subscription Fee on each renewal by not more than five percent (5%), on sixty (60) days' written notice.

## 5. SERVICE LEVELS

5.1 The Provider shall make the Platform available at least 99.5% of the time in each calendar month, excluding scheduled maintenance notified at least forty-eight (48) hours in advance.

5.2 If availability falls below 99.5% in a month, the Customer is entitled to a service credit of 5% of the monthly equivalent of the Annual Subscription Fee for each full 0.5% shortfall, up to 30%. Service credits are the Customer's sole remedy for availability failures, other than the right to terminate under Clause 10.3.

## 6. DATA

6.1 The Customer owns all data it uploads to the Platform ("**Customer Data**"). The Provider shall use Customer Data only to provide the Platform.

## 7. LIABILITY

7.1 The Provider's liability to the Customer under or in connection with this Agreement shall be unlimited.

7.2 The Customer's liability to the Provider for any claim shall be unlimited.

7.3 Neither Party shall be liable for indirect or consequential loss.

7.4 Notwithstanding Clauses 7.1 and 7.2 and anything else in this Agreement, and except for Excluded Liabilities, each Party's total aggregate liability to the other shall not exceed the Cap.

## 8. CONFIDENTIALITY

8.1 Each Party shall protect the other's confidential information with at least reasonable care and use it only to perform or receive the benefit of this Agreement. This obligation survives for five (5) years after termination.

## 9. INDEMNITY

9.1 The Provider shall indemnify the Customer against third-party claims that the Platform infringes intellectual property rights in India.

## 10. TERMINATION

10.1 Either Party may terminate for material breach not cured within thirty (30) days of notice.

10.2 The Customer may terminate for convenience at any time on thirty (30) days' notice, subject to payment of the Early Termination Fee. No refund of prepaid fees is due except as stated in Clause 10.4.

10.3 If the Platform availability is below 95% in any two (2) consecutive months, the Customer may terminate on written notice without payment of the Early Termination Fee.

10.4 On termination under Clause 10.1 by the Customer or under Clause 10.3, the Provider shall refund prepaid fees for the period after termination within thirty (30) days.

## 11. RESTRICTIVE COVENANT

11.1 During the Subscription Term and for twelve (12) months after, the Customer shall not use any analytics platform competing with the Provider's Platform.

11.2 Clause 11.1 does not apply to any analytics tool already in use by the Customer as of the date of this Agreement, which are listed in Schedule 3.

## 12. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTES

12.1 This Agreement is governed by Indian law. Disputes shall be resolved by arbitration in Delhi by a sole arbitrator jointly appointed by the Parties, or failing agreement within thirty (30) days, appointed by the Delhi International Arbitration Centre.
